AUTHOR: Schmid, MS; Cowen, RK; Robinson, K; Luo, JY; Briseño-Avena, C; Sponaugle, S
TITLE: Prey and predator overlap at the edge of a mesoscale eddy: fine-scale, in-situ distributions to inform our understanding of oceanographic processes
REGION: Straits of Florida, off the Florida Keys, USA (pelagic, mesoscale eddy)
SPECIES: Larval fishes (one group) among 124 plankton/particle classes mapped to 40 groups (e.g., Oithona spp., calanoid copepods, appendicularians)
DATA: Own ISIIS towed shadowgraph imagery, 2014 and 2015 summer cruises (132 million image segments)
V_EV: Methods, Eddy Sampling: 'This sampling included 13 multi-hour transects where the ISIIS imager was undulating from 3 to 80 m depth'
D2: Train 61,571 vignettes (2014); test 138,374 (threshold tuning) and 143,418 (final) vignettes randomly from 2014+2015
D_EV: Methods, Testing the sCNN: '138,374 vignettes were randomly extracted from all 2014 and 2015 cruise data and manually identified'
R_EV: Methods: 'Within the 2014 dataset ... 61,571 vignettes ... selected to train'; final test 'vignettes from 2014 and 2015 data' (pooled, no separate scores)
C_EV: Methods: 'Loess model to determine at which probability threshold a cut-off should be made ... to reach 90% classification precision'; low-confidence 're-classified as unknown'
E_EV: Results: 'Average corrected concentrations of larval fishes were 5.6 and 2.3 ind. m-3 on transects 1 and 8, respectively.'
ARCH: Sparse CNN (SparseConvNet with fractional max-pooling); k-harmonic means ROI segmentation; Random Forests for ecological drivers
METR: Precision, recall, F1 (weighted and per group)
NOTE: Plankton imaging study; larval fish is one group (P 88.2%, R 41.2%, F1 56.2%). PLAT: ISIIS is a towed undulating imager (closest option 트롤 카메라); ENV pelagic open water has no matching option -> NR. R1=Y because classifier trained on 2014 data only and test sets include 2015 cruise data (different year), but results pooled -> R3=N; low confidence. Per-class probability thresholds tuned for 90% precision, below-threshold -> unknown (C4=Y). Concentrations corrected by precision/recall factor; correction validated only by citation (ref 38), not in this paper -> E2=N, E5 없음. E4=FNR because per-group recall reported and used in correction. DSHR: ISIIS data at BCO-DMO.
